inventories.finding: All images are repository-authored linear analytic court fixtures. They contain rigid/affine truth only and are already development-open; they do not provide nonlinear PE truth, acquired-data labels, or a sealed nonlinear cohort.
The supplied Flashalign Python scripts and numerical check JSON are algebra oracles, not MRI inputs. The previously documented IBSR archive is absent from Downloads.
One MNI T1w template is present. A template alone supplies neither subject pairing nor independent deformation truth, labels, PE metadata, reverse-PE data, or fieldmap data.

The top-level assets are a small set of T1/template images and one single-subject BOLD example plus derived exploratory outputs. There are no BIDS sidecars, reverse-PE pairs, fieldmaps, independent PE landmarks, or a sealed subject-disjoint Flashalign cohort.

This is an explicitly dirty exploratory work area containing repeated derived outputs. Its IBSR18 subcourt has 18 labeled T1 subjects and nine disjoint pairs, but it was unblinded on 2026-09-08, is documented as one diagnostic cohort, and has already informed HodgeFlow assessment. It has no PE acquisition strata and cannot serve as an unopened multi-cohort Flashalign audit.

ibsr18.role_for_flashalign: future development/comparison input only after a separately frozen adapter and manifest; not sealed nonlinear accuracy evidence

implementation_ingress_audit.finding: The optimizer and matrix-free kernels exist, but only synthetic test objectives currently connect image evidence to the nonlinear objective interfaces. The benchmark runner therefore has no frozen image-backed nonlinear fit lane to execute against acquired volumes.

blockers.detail: No subject-disjoint EPI-to-anatomy cohort with PE direction, independent geometric evaluation, and the required ordinary, large-initialization, partial-slab and low-signal strata is present.
No reverse-PE common-domain or fieldmap-assisted data and metadata are present; these claims remain separate and unavailable.
IBSR18 is a useful labeled development/comparison cohort, but it is already unblinded, contains one cohort and lacks the required failure-tail strata and independent untouched confirmation cohort.
No production or benchmark implementation supplies acquired image values and gradients through the frozen projected-patch nonlinear objective interfaces.
